method: Codex in-app browser native static publisher/current vs authored MM path comparison
findings: Original domestic logical11 is an ordinary downward vertical with no left hook, confirmed at .1/.5/1 of its original CSS clock.
The authored MM logical11 has a pronounced leftward hooked end. This is a stroke-end mismatch requiring correction, not accepted as a font-weight difference.
The other16 static selections occupy corresponding stroke roles; serif contours, slopes and point shapes differ between source fonts.
Authored logical17 is an ordinary unhooked vertical and is a possible same-glyph public donor for a new explicit affine candidate. Donor placement and corrected whole remain unreviewed.
next: Prepare a same-glyph unhooked vertical donor placement from public source anchors, preserve original D/median and all other16 parts, then directly compare the new logical11 and corrected whole.
